outOfScope: Do not add or configure new external providers; source coverage and provider availability belong to wi-weekly-radar-source-coverage.
Do not change data, pending refs, publication receipts, archive retention, schedule cadence, or Telegram delivery behavior.
Do not generate Top5 or any ranking when the user has not supplied an explicit company selection.
Do not merge system reference and human judgment, and do not produce trading or capital-action conclusions.
Do not add LLM extraction, provider-authority reinterpretation, or unsupported facts to make the report look more complete.

preReviewWarnings: Review every expanded fact and source link for evidence traceability.
Review that system reference remains independent from human judgment and that missing evidence is explained rather than hidden.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The user-facing report expands every confirmed information item with company, information type, concise fact, date when supplied, and a directly traceable evidence link; it does not invent or promote unconfirmed leads.
Each company has an explainable system-reference block that shows the reference state, supporting or missing evidence reason, and relevant evidence links; it remains separate from any human judgment.
The report distinguishes no-confirmed-change, evidence-insufficient, and source-unavailable states instead of collapsing them into a generic system-unable message.
A generic source entry is not presented as the direct primary evidence for every company; when only an entry point exists, the report states that direct evidence is unavailable.

The report continues to omit ranking when no explicit company selection is supplied, preserves the no-trading boundary, and remains valid for supported report languages and Telegram semantic splitting.

Automated tests cover expanded confirmed facts, evidence-insufficient system references, source-unavailable explanations, independent human-reference semantics, no-ranking behavior, and deterministic rendering.
User-facing Weekly Radar documentation and the capability overview describe the expanded content and its evidence limitations.
The changed semantic splitter is covered through the repository's existing module-based splitter test association.
guidelines: Every user-visible fact or judgment explanation must remain traceable to supplied evidence; do not fill gaps with inference.
Keep system reference and human judgment independent; neither may be described as agreement, voting, or a shared answer.
No explicit company selection means no ranking; report content must not become a trading or capital-action recommendation.
User-facing documentation must describe the content, evidence limits, and unavailable-source states without exposing internal diagnostics.

intent.problem: The delivered 2026-08-24 report is readable but mostly exposes aggregate counts and source status: the 9 confirmed items are not expanded, every company's system reference is only '暂无法判断', and a generic research entry point is shown as the main evidence. The user needs a report that explains what was confirmed and why the system reference is or is not available.
constraints: Preserve the existing evidence-first model and do not turn discovery leads or unavailable sources into confirmed facts.
Keep the system's reference separate from a person's independent judgment; do not merge or vote between them.
Do not change provider configuration, data-branch publication, schedule cadence, or Telegram delivery in this Work Item.
Do not generate ranking without an explicit user-provided company selection and do not add capital-action conclusions.
intent.rationale: The smallest useful correction is to improve the report presentation and evidence explanation using facts already carried by the snapshot, while keeping source coverage as a separate follow-up Work Item.
